title: Convex
summary: CONVEX, adjective [Latin] Rising or swelling on the exterior surface into a spherical or round form; gibbous; opposed to concave, which expresses a round form of the interior surface; as a convex mirr

inlines.v: CONVEX, adjective [Latin] Rising or swelling on the exterior surface into a spherical or round form; gibbous; opposed to concave, which expresses a round form of the interior surface; as a convex mirror or lens. CONVEX, noun A convex body; as heavens convex
